text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Nakayama Festa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Nakayama Festa's gaze
was a crane game filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Back then, I'd skip school all the time and kill time here.
choice_data_list: Wanna see who can catch more?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You've got guts, I'll give ya that.
Not to boast, but I'm pretty damn good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
First, let's see what you've got.
Get my blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
